warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: : wait for Supabase, then start Next.js with its URL and key; until out=$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^API_URL="http'; do sleep 2; done; v() { printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n "s/^$1=\"\\(.*\\)\"$/\\1/p" | head -n1; }; SUPABASE_URL=$(v API_URL); SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(v PUBLISHABLE_KEY); [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ] || SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(v ANON_KEY); export SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
